message.content: The image contains no person; it is a still life of orange and white capsule pills (marked "S489 30 mg") spilling from a translucent white prescription bottle onto a solid, bright orange surface. The composition is captured in a landscape orientation with a high-resolution, clean aesthetic that emphasizes sharp detail on the pills in the foreground while the bottle remains slightly out of focus. The overall mood is clinical and sterile, evoking themes of healthcare, medication, and mental health through its minimalist color palette and organized yet scattered arrangement.
